expected: Tokenized prompt plus reserved output within actual limit; near-limit tool follow-up; explicit overflow error.
limitations: The integration still declares the window 1,024 tokens below the engine's; OMP 18.4.4+ adds its own 64-token headway (can1357/oh-my-pi#13499), which was not relied on.
A single prompt above ~130K tokens cannot be sent at all; OMP compacts long sessions before that point.
observed: Engine tokenizer boundary: a 100,030-token prompt is accepted with max_tokens 31,034 and refused (HTTP 400, 'requests are never truncated') with 31,035, i.e. prompt + max_tokens + 8 <= 131,072; its cold prefill took 15.6 s. With the production configuration stock OMP 18.4.6 completed a near-limit typed tool task: prompts of 104,810-105,670 tokens with OMP-fitted output caps of 15,544-24,656 (largest prompt+cap 129,997, below the declared 130,048 window), both facts written by the write tool, exit 0, no compaction; the first near-limit prefill (104,810 tokens) took 16.2 s and the three continuations reused 104,805+ tokens each. A single ~136K-token attachment is refused explicitly: HTTP 400 surfaced by OMP, exit 1, no engine work.
